style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he sprints left to right on long legs in every beat, the camera running beside him at his height, so the money walls tear past behind him in every beat; loose notes or a chick wipe the lens in every beat; he fills half the frame height, chest up from 7.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the notes fly to him, he works the soft one only at a full run; no push in, no rack focus
character: a tall pink flamingo in a grey banker waistcoat, long black beak, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean flamingo teller in a green visor sprinting at the lens all clip, flinging notes; A SWARM of pink chicks crossing the lens in every beat
props: two identical blue notes the teller flings, a gale of loose notes gusting past his legs
prop_continuity: the notes are the teller and always in flight until his beak takes them; the second note stays limp and crumpled from 5.2 on; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow bank corridor where bricks of banknotes fill both walls to the ceiling, violet first, then green, then blue, a paper gale blowing through

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.1 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: bank-NO-ty, o-di-NA-ko-vy-e, ha-RAK-ter, u fto-ROY, MYAG-che
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.2 one breath; pause 2.2-6.4; 6.4-8.4 one breath; after 8.4 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: running footfalls all clip, paper storm rustling, wing flutter, one dry sheet metal ring at 2.4, one soft squelch at 4.6, a crumpling rustle at 5.6

timeline.a: he bursts into frame at a full run, a wingtip dragging along the violet bricks tearing past, and the teller sprinting beside him thrusts two identical blue notes at the lens
the teller flicks both notes spinning side by side across the whole frame, flashing the same, and he runs on under them, his wingtip slapping the green bricks
he snaps the first note out of the air in his beak at a full run and it stays board stiff, ringing like sheet metal, ricocheting past the lens unbent
the teller flings the second note in spinning, matched to the first, both of them tearing past a wall of blue bricks
he snaps the second note the same way mid-run and his beak sinks straight through it, the paper going limp
still at a full run he plucks the limp note off his beak with one foot and scrubs it between both feet mid-stride, the paper crumpling like toilet paper, the gale bursting up around him
he shakes the crumpled note at the lens without slowing, a chick tearing across in front of him
chest-up, face to camera, still running, the limp note hanging off his foot as the walls streak behind
he scrubs it once more between his feet at a run and the paper tears in half, both halves slapping past the lens
he sprints on, the teller swept aside behind him, the swarm tearing across the lens

must_appear: at 2.2 he snaps the first note in his beak at a run and it rings off stiff past the lens; at 4.6 his beak sinks straight through the second note and it goes limp; at 5.2 he plucks it off his beak with one foot and scrubs it between both feet at a full run, crumpling like toilet paper; at 8.4 it tears in half, face to camera, still running
negative_prompt: speech bubble, speech balloon, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a hero sitting, a hero riding, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 8.4
